goal: Prevent dropping mineable transactions, like low-feerate parents awaiting a fee bump, purely due to age
Reduce per-entry mempool memory overhead by removing the entry time index
agreement: Unaddressed objection: test no longer checks parent resubmission before its child (fametrano)
Objection: removing expiry prevents operators from reverting to previous default behavior (ajtowns)
Concept support because reasons for expiry no longer hold and cleanup is beneficial (stickies-v, maflcko)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because age-based eviction is incentive-incompatible and can drop still-mineable transactions
Lowers per-entry dynamic memory usage so the mempool fits more transactions under the same budget
